name: Contract Bridge
description: A fixed four-seat contract bridge board with a legal auction, declarer and dummy control, strict follow-suit play, duplicate scoring, and private hands.

rules.table: Exactly four stable seats are North, East, South, and West. North-South play against East-West. A standard 52-card deck deals thirteen cards to every seat.
rules.auction: Calls rotate from the board dealer. Legal calls are pass, a higher bid from 1C through 7NT, double of an opposing undoubled contract, and redouble by the doubled declaring side. Four opening passes pass out the board; otherwise three passes end the auction.
rules.declarer: The first player on the winning partnership who bid the final denomination is declarer. Declarer's left-hand opponent leads. Dummy is exposed after the opening lead and declarer submits dummy's plays.
rules.play: Every hand must follow the led suit when able. Trump wins over non-trump; otherwise the highest card in the led suit wins. Thirteen tricks complete the board.
rules.scoring: Duplicate bridge scoring covers trick values, game and part-score bonuses, doubled and redoubled contracts, overtricks, undertricks, slams, and board vulnerability.
rules.scope: This protocol does not model director rulings, irregular calls or plays, alerts, claims, or tournament movement.
rules.privacy: Only the current Leader stores all four hands. A Member sees only its own hand until dummy becomes public.
rules.recovery: A Leader change preserves cumulative partnership score, discards the compromised board, and redeals the same board number.
